title: What the live paper record shows
description: The engines' own state, read from the running record: what is open, what closed, and what the market filter is doing right now.
body:
Paper signals only. No real orders are placed anywhere in this record. This note reports the live paper record as it stands, in plain language, with no projection. Every position described here is paper, and one trade says nothing about a strategy. The engines' own state is read from the running record: what is open, what closed, and what the market filter is doing right now.

## What the record is

Live starts: v005 counts its live record from 1 October 2026 and v006 from 9 October 2026. The first live signal was an ATOM entry at 2.066 after the 10 October 2026 daily close. ATOM exited below its 10-day low at the 18 October 2026 close, at 1.703, which is -17.9% after the 30 bps round trip. A NEAR entry at 5.896 on 12 October 2026 has been open since. In testing, most trades lost and the average winner was roughly +19%, so a losing start is the expected case rather than a surprise. That expectation is a statement about the tested distribution, not a claim that any future trade will follow it.

## Open positions

htf-rsi-v007 shows 0 positions open on paper. trend-daily-v005 shows 0 positions open on paper. trend-daily-v006 shows 0 positions open on paper. The NEAR entry at 5.896 on 12 October 2026 has been open since, and it is the only open position named in this record. For htf-rsi-v007, trend-daily-v005, and trend-daily-v006, the paper book is flat at the time of the snapshot. A flat paper book means no unrealized paper gain or loss is being carried by those engines in the record.

## Closed trades

htf-rsi-v007 has 5 closed trades so far, with average null net per trade. trend-daily-v005 has 6 closed trades so far, with average -13.22% net per trade. trend-daily-v006 has 7 closed trades so far, with average -13.34% net per trade. The ATOM trade is the most recent closed trade described in the record: entry at 2.066 after the 10 October 2026 daily close and exit at 1.703 on 18 October 2026, for -17.9% after the 30 bps round trip. These are realized paper results. They show what happened, not what will happen, and they do not by themselves establish whether either trend engine is working.

## Market filter and breakout distances

trend-daily-v005 has the Bitcoin market filter off. trend-daily-v006 has the Bitcoin market filter off. Both trend engines show 0 positions open on paper, so the record shows no triggered trend entry under the current filter state. The listed distances are how far each symbol is from its 20-day breakout level:

- For v005: TRXUSDT is 12.57% below its high; AAVEUSDT is 16.30% below its high; XLMUSDT is 17.87% below its high.
- For v006: JUPUSDT is 6.80% below its high; TRXUSDT is 12.57% below its high; AAVEUSDT is 16.30% below its high.

These distances are measurements from the running record. They describe how far the named symbols are from the stated breakout levels. They are not instructions to trade.

## Reading the record

Paper means no real orders are placed anywhere in this record. A closed paper trade records a hypothetical entry and exit; it does not create a gain or loss in a real account. The average net per trade is a summary of closed paper trades, and "average null net per trade" is the value reported for htf-rsi-v007. Because the live records began on 1 October 2026 and 9 October 2026, the number of closed trades is small. A small number of paper trades cannot settle whether an engine has an edge. The ATOM result and the averages for trend-daily-v005 and trend-daily-v006 are therefore reported as observations, not as evidence of future performance.

## Where to check

The same numbers appear on the performance page, in the signal log, and in the status posted to the channel. This live snapshot was read at 2026-11-18T15:21:30.782Z. The record updates continuously, so the open positions, closed trades, and filter state can change after that timestamp.
